# litert-lm-kmp

> Run LLMs on the phone from Kotlin Multiplatform: one API in commonMain for Android, iOS and the JVM, on Google's LiteRT-LM. Summarization, proofreading, rewriting, image description and chat on a LiteRT-LM model, and with the artifact `litertlm-genai-nano` also on Gemini Nano through ML Kit GenAI on Android phones that have it. No API key. An independent project, not a Google product.

Pin `io.github.john-rocky.litertlm:litertlm-genai:0.1.0`. It runs LiteRT-LM 0.19.0 and needs Kotlin 2.3.0 or newer and `minSdk` 24. For Gemini Nano on Android, also add `io.github.john-rocky.litertlm:litertlm-genai-nano:0.1.0` to `androidMain`, with `minSdk` 26: the code stays the same. On iOS, also add the Swift package `https://github.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp`, product `CLiteRTLM`. On 2026-11-05 an iPhone 18 Pro summarized the Gettysburg Address in 0.9 s and a Pixel 8a in 5.2 s, with Gemma 4 E2B on the GPU and the model already loaded.

```kotlin
// commonMain. The first request downloads Gemma 4 E2B (2.6 GB) unless Gemini Nano answers. Keep the screen on until it ends.
val summarizer = Summarization.getClient(SummarizerOptions.builder().build())
val summary = summarizer.runInference(SummarizationRequest.builder(article).build()).summary
```

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/README.md): install and what you can call.
- [docs/install.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/install.md): every detail of the install, on Android, iOS and the JVM.
- [docs/tasks.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/tasks.md): tasks and chat.
- [docs/who-answers.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/who-answers.md): Gemini Nano or the local model.
- [docs/choose-the-model.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/choose-the-model.md): choosing the model.
- [docs/lower-level.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/lower-level.md): `Engine`, `Conversation`, `EmbeddingEngine`.
- [docs/compose-multiplatform.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/compose-multiplatform.md): Compose Multiplatform.
- [docs/failures.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/failures.md): failures.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/AGENTS.md): for coding agents. Task → API → file, and the rules that fail on a real device.
- [docs/tested-devices.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/tested-devices.md): each phone, OS, runtime version, provider and backend, what ran, and how to run the checks yourself.
- [docs/koog.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/koog.md): a small Koog `LLMClient` over `Engine`.
- [docs/ios-tests.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/docs/ios-tests.md): the runtime in a Kotlin test binary on iOS.
- [Package.swift](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/Package.swift): the product `CLiteRTLM`, Google's release of the runtime with its checksum.

## API, tasks (litertlm-genai)

- [summarization/Summarization.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-genai/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/genai/summarization/Summarization.kt): `Summarization.getClient`, `SummarizerOptions`, `SummarizationRequest`. Proofreading, rewriting and image description have the same shape, in the directories next to it.
- [prompt/Generation.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-genai/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/genai/prompt/Generation.kt): `Generation.getClient`, `GenerativeModel`, `generateContent`, `generateContentStream`.
- [common/ModelProvider.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-genai/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/genai/common/ModelProvider.kt): `ModelProvider.Auto`, `GeminiNano`, `LiteRtLm`, and `LocalModel`.
- [common/GenAiException.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-genai/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/genai/common/GenAiException.kt): the error codes.

## API, Gemini Nano (litertlm-genai-nano)

- [README, Gemini Nano](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/README.md): one dependency in `androidMain`, no API of its own. `ModelProvider` chooses.

## API, lower level (litertlm-kmp)

- [Engine.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-kmp/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/Engine.kt): `Engine`, `initialize`, `createConversation`.
- [Conversation.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-kmp/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/Conversation.kt): `sendMessage`, `stream`, `cancelProcess`.
- [Config.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-kmp/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/Config.kt): `EngineConfig`, `ConversationConfig`, `Backend`.
- [Message.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-kmp/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/Message.kt): `Message`, `Contents`, `Content`.
- [Tool.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-kmp/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/Tool.kt): `tool`, `OpenApiTool`.
- [EmbeddingEngine.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-kmp/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/EmbeddingEngine.kt): `EmbeddingEngine`, `computeEmbedding`.
- [LiteRtLmException.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/main/litertlm-kmp/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/litertlm/LiteRtLmException.kt): the failure types.

## Examples

- [sample-shared](https://github.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/tree/main/sample-shared), [sample-android](https://github.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/tree/main/sample-android), [sample-ios](https://github.com/john-rocky/litert-lm-kmp/tree/main/sample-ios): one Compose screen with a chat and every task, with the provider and backend to choose.

## Related

- [swift-litert-lm](https://github.com/john-rocky/swift-litert-lm): LiteRT-LM from Swift, with Apple's Foundation Models API.
- [hfmodels-android](https://github.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android): Hugging Face models in an Android app.
- [hf-to-litertlm](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm): convert a Hugging Face LLM or VLM to `.litertlm`.
